text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board. —In other words, a 
defeat.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But anything other than first place 
is a loss. I cannot afford to rest on 
those words.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's investigate the causes of the defeat 
thoroughly. Even if, for example, it 
simply came down to "luck"—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to reflect on why I couldn't 
overcome that luck, or what invited it, 
and prepare for the next challenge.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... But only after getting proper 
rest!
Yeah... after getting plenty of rest!

Let's stay focused and tighten our 
discipline even more.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Since I only placed on the board, I'll 
have to hold off on breaking in my new 
bath goods.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I've been preparing for this with such 
excitement, but... I'll save that 
excitement for when I win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started right away. First, 
regarding right after the start...
choice_data_list: Wait! Let's at least get changed first.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I got ahead of myself... I'll 
go change right away!
